name: assay-flowcell-material-system
description: Use when a FlowCell material, coating, membrane, polymer, electrolyte, electrofluid, ion/mineral system, or active-maintenance material needs qualification for a named engineering function.
preconditions: the material/system and intended engineering function are named
the relevant freshwater/seawater and exposure envelope is identifiable
postconditions: compatibility and cycling evidence is recorded
energy and mass accounting is present for storage or active-maintenance claims
input-shape: FlowCell scientific/configuration evidence appropriate to the named procedure
output-shape: Typed FlowCell scientific evidence packet described by the postconditions
